status_plain: No reading of CUMIPMT with a recorded Excel build was found in the harvested evidence. No input has been read in two environments, so no difference is known and none is ruled out. A CPU dependence is expected and untested (see below). No reading from a Mac, Excel for the web, 32-bit Excel or an Intel CPU is recorded.

sensitivities.statement: Handbook evidence record EV-FIN-0005 marks 7 of its counts for this function as CPU-scoped: the counted result depends on how the host CPU executes x87 instructions. Every reading recorded here was taken on an AMD Zen 2 processor or on a host whose CPU was not recorded; no reading on an Intel CPU, a Mac or Excel for the web exists, so a CPU difference is neither observed nor ruled out.
